title.en: The access matrix and public space

aim.en: You can map pedestrian circulation, tactile guide paths, urban furniture, and calculate total distances and travel times for different user profiles in an access matrix.
aim.sr: Umeš da mapiraš pešačke tokove, taktilne staze vodilje, urbani mobilijar i izračunaš dužine putanja i vreme kretanja za različite profile korisnika u matrici pristupa.

bring.en: Slope map from week 7, tracing paper or CAD layer, drafting pens.
bring.sr: Karta nagiba iz 7. nedelje, paus papir ili CAD sloj, crtaći pribor.

text.en: One route for all: computing the access matrix
text.sr: Jedan put za sve: proračun matrice pristupa

text.en: Equitable use means no segregated entrances or detour tracks. In the access matrix, every user profile is calculated: distance from arrival, vertical rise, rest stops, and travel time. Separate pathways are an automatic design failure.
text.sr: Ravnopravna upotreba znači da nema odvojenih ulaza ni zaobilaznih staza. U matrici pristupa računamo svaki profil: dužinu od dolaska, uspon, odmorišta i vreme kretanja. Razdvajanje staza je automatski pad projekta.

items.en: If a wheelchair user must travel 280 m while an ambulatory visitor travels 40 m, can that still be called universal design?
items.sr: Ako korisnik kolica mora da pređe 280 m dok osoba bez teškoća prelazi 40 m, može li se to uopšte nazvati univerzalnim dizajnom?
